services.name: Main Duck Island Excursion
services.desc: Explore Main Duck Island Rates Private Cruise - $1,650 Duration approx.10 hours About Main Duck Island is the most Southern tip of Prince Edward County. Long a favourite of Lake Ontario sailors, it marks the eastern end of the Lake. Exclusive to boaters, you can now visit and explore Main Duck with us. This is a full day excursion. Anchor in Schoolhouse Bay and explore the island. Snacks and light refreshments provided. What to Bring Sunscreen Hat Bathing suit Towel
